lessons_used: Predictions were mostly too high compared to actual noise-corrected results, except for sign_in notification where the prediction was too low.
No effect was seen for adoption redesign changes across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_flow, finish new_screen, home new_flow, sign_in notification, and sign_in reorder, as each has only 1 test.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Progress Checklist Flow
candidates.change: Adds a live multi-step rendering checklist and an animated mascot onto the waiting screen during generation.
candidates.why: Home / waiting stage has a long mean completion time (2336s) and 3 support tickets reported custom pet rendering confusion.

guard.reason: Valid enhancement to the waiting screen with no rule violations.

candidates.score_note: High evidence from wait time and support tickets, but historical new_flow test on home yielded -1.3% lift.

candidates.title: Sign In After Story Intro
candidates.change: Moves sign_in directly after story intro so users sync their account before selecting paths or adopting pets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about lost pets or account resets after signing in later in the journey.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save Progress
sign_in.hint: Sync your account early so your pet selection and custom creations are saved safely.

guard.reason: sign_in may move later, not before choose_path

candidates.title: Choose Path Welcome Onboarding Screen
candidates.change: Inserts a dedicated onboarding intro screen before path choice explaining ready-made versus photo-created pets.
candidates.why: Choose path drops off to 76.2% conversion and has a high mean duration of 514s due to user hesitation.

new_path_welcome.headline: Choose Your Journey
new_path_welcome.body: Select whether to adopt an instant ready-made desktop pet or upload photos to generate a custom companion.

guard.reason: Adding a new onboarding screen before path selection is allowed by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Adding a new screen adds friction, similar to prior new_screen tests (-6.0%), with no support mail backing.

candidates.title: Home Intro Onboarding Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the home intro screen into a focused stage layout featuring a prominent mascot preview and call-to-action.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% and 3 support tickets report confusion on how to launch or interact with pets.

home_intro.headline: Welcome Your Pet to the Desktop!
home_intro.body: Your companion is ready! Click below to summon it onto your desktop screen.

guard.reason: replacement for 'home_intro.home_welcome' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'] with real words

candidates.title: Sign In Recovery Account Guidance
candidates.change: Clarifies sign-in headline and body copy to emphasize account restoration for returning users.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails from users whose pets went missing or reset when signing in with another account.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Access Your Pets
sign_in.body: Use your existing account to restore all previously adopted desktop companions and settings automatically.
sign_in.hint: Make sure to sign in with the same email or provider you used previously.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Path Decision Time Helper Hint
candidates.change: Adds explicit hint copy informing users that path choice is flexible and additional pets can be added later.
candidates.why: Choose path median completion time is 8s while mean time is 514s, showing a long tail of stalled users.

choose_path.hint: Unsure? You can always create or adopt additional pets later from your desktop menu.

guard.reason: Adding helpful decision hints to path selection is compliant with all rules.

candidates.score_note: Low cost copy fix for stalled users; mild positive expectation without major flow disruption.

candidates.title: Background Pet Readiness Notification
candidates.change: Enables system notifications on the waiting screen so users know they can minimize the app while pet generation completes.
candidates.why: Waiting stage mean time is 2336s (over 38 minutes), leading users to close or abandon the app during generation.

waiting.headline: We'll Notify You When Ready
waiting.body: Feel free to minimize this window. We will send a desktop notification as soon as your pet is generated.

guard.reason: Adding background notifications to the waiting screen is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Addresses 38-minute wait abandonment; notifications are the only change type with positive historical precedent (+7.6%).

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Estimated Time & Carousel
candidates.change: Displays time estimates and a tips carousel explaining desktop controls while pet generation finishes.
candidates.why: Mean time waiting is 2336s and 3 users wrote support because they did not know how to control desktop features.

components.text: Tip: Right-click your pet anytime on the desktop to hide, move, or chat with it.

guard.reason: Adding tips and real wait estimates to the waiting screen complies with Rules 4 and 5.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from support and wait duration; informative carousel provides minor clarity without adding flow friction.

candidates.title: Upload Photos Checklist Layout
candidates.change: Switches the upload photos screen to a structured checklist layout with explicit photo requirements.
candidates.why: 3 support emails mentioned custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption conversion is low at 60.9%.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Clear Pet Photos
upload_photos.hint: For best results, upload high-resolution, front-facing photos with good lighting.

guard.reason: Redesigning the photo upload layout is permitted inside onboarding under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Targets the highest funnel drop-off (39.1% lost) with support mail backing, but prior adoption redesigns consistently showed negative lift (-1.3%).

candidates.title: Pick Friend Character Selection Badge
candidates.change: Adds a starter care package badge to pet choices to increase motivation during character selection.
candidates.why: Adoption stage drops to 60.9% conversion with a median time of 89s.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions 'Free Starter Toy Pack', violating Rule 3 which prohibits mentioning free extras or gifts.
